tasks.title: Reply to a ticket
tasks.when: a customer writes and an answer is due
steps: Find the order or account the ticket is about.
Answer from the help articles; quote the article.
Escalate to a person when money back, a legal threat or an angry repeat is involved.
tasks.output: a draft reply in the ticket

examples.input: Order 5531 arrived broken, I want my money back.

tasks.title: Weekly themes from tickets
tasks.when: the week ends and the team reviews what customers asked
steps: Group the week's tickets by theme.
Count each theme and quote one ticket.
Propose one help article to write or fix.

examples.input: 12 tickets about delivery delays, 4 about sizes.
